classification: offline reference analysis; not a firmware 6.02 verification
method: Read ELF program/dynamic headers and symbols; locate exports by the converter's symbol-name hash; inspect bounded function disassembly locally. Firmware binaries and instruction extracts are not committed.

exit_reference.inference: The 6.02 fault offset matches the instruction after syscall 1 in this 12.70 reference. This supports a final process-exit syscall failure but does not establish identical code or kernel behavior on 6.02.

shell_exit_reference.observed_interface: No incoming argument consumed; returns an integer result from a service call.
shell_exit_reference.qualification: Not called. Firmware 6.02 binding and behavior remain unverified.

with_value_caution: The reference sceShellCoreUtilExitAppWithValue reads its argument as a pointer and bounds a string copy; do not guess that it accepts an integer exit status.

loader_callback_reference.observation: Loader initialization writes the callback address through its second argument. The entry trampoline places this value in RSI before jumping to the application. The callback walks loaded-module records and invokes their finalizers, then returns.
loader_callback_reference.limitation: This supports treating the second native entry argument as a teardown callback in the 12.70 reference. It does not prove callback completion in the 6.02 run or explain kernel exit policy.

converter_constraint.finding: Stub loading sets library_name=module_name. The writer allocates exactly one import library per needed module. That cannot express libSceShellCoreUtil inside libSceSystemService without an explicit library mapping change.
converter_constraint.next_step: Implement and host-test explicit import-library mapping before considering a shell-exit candidate. Keep current imports unchanged and reject ambiguous mappings.
